servinfo.title: Dual Sensor Brake Support Control Module Removal and Installation

attention4.ptxt: Do not drop or otherwise expose the dual sensor brake support control module to large shock. Any dual sensor brake support control module that has received large shock should be replaced.

item.ptxt: When replacing dual sensor brake support control module, use new control module. If used one is installed, DTC (C1681) could be detected due to mismatch of each registration.
After replacing dual sensor brake support control module, perform Dual Sensor Brake Support Control Module Aiming Adjustment:Dual Sensor Brake Support and check DTC.

When dual sensor brake support control module is replaced, traffic sign recognition function is setting ON. When necessary, traffic sign recognition function is setting OFF by operation of user customization function in combination meter.

s1.ptxt: Remove dual sensor brake support control module cover (1) as follows.

s2.ptxt: Unhooking claws (2) of dual sensor brake support control module holder (3) using a flat-bladed screwdriver or the like.
Remove dual sensor brake support control module cover (1) from dual sensor brake support control module holder (2) by moving it in arrow direction.

s1.ptxt: Disconnect connector and remove dual sensor brake support control module (1) by pushing claws (2) in arrow direction all together.
Remove dual sensor brake support control module (1) from dual sensor brake support control module holder (2) by moving it in arrow direction.

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Check that claws (1) of dual sensor brake support control module (2) fixed to the holder (3) securely.
After installation, check that dual sensor brake support control module is no looseness, wobble or abnormal noise.
After installation, perform Dual Sensor Brake Support Control Module Aiming Adjustment:Dual Sensor Brake Support .
